answer: Admission to terrace needs two sponsors with disjoint sponsorship ancestry, each burning ferrous equal to the count of onyx it has already backed plus one. A sponsor's kth onyx costs k ferrous, read and incremented on one counter at commit, so a batch cannot split the bill; n clones backed by two outsiders cost n(n+1) ferrous, attached to the entry of each onyx. It breaks if ferrous is refundable or ancestry can be hidden.
